hints.title: Non Increasing Order Property
hints.text: Both arrays are sorted in descending order, meaning larger indices correspond to smaller values.

hints.title: Monotonic Two Pointer Movement
hints.text: For a fixed i, advance j as far as possible while nums1[i] <= nums2[j].

hints.title: Advance Pointer on Violation
hints.text: When nums1[i] exceeds nums2[j], increment i to find a smaller value that can match with future j positions.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all pairs naively requires O(n * m) time, timing out for 10^5 elements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual monotonic pointer scan traverses both arrays in linear O(n + m) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate guarantees i <= j and leverages descending monotonicity.
